speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have been experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis; have these symptoms started suddenly or developed gradually?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your symptoms persisted despite improvement in your sinus infection, did you develop any changes in your urine, such as increased frequency, urgency, or a distinct change in color?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The history of a rash appearing after amoxicillin and resolving with cephalexin suggests an amoxicillin sensitivity. Did you experience any nausea, vomiting, or abdominal pain alongside the flank pain and fever?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and Blood_Culture

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your initial urinalysis and blood culture results were normal, have you noticed any visible blood in your urine or passed any "pea-soup" colored urine recently? Also, have you been experiencing painful urination or blood in your stool?

REQUEST TEST: Urine_Culture and Microscopy

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal microscopy and culture results make a typical bacterial infection unlikely. Did you notice any dark, tea-colored urine or tea-colored urine after starting the antibiotics, and do you have a history of kidney stones or sickle cell trait? REQUEST TEST: Serum Creatinine and Bilirubin
